segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The van stood at the head of the Long Quay with its horses in and its lamps lit against the grey. It was slate blue. Mace was on the box and Nairn beside him, with Ruddock and Tibb and Stiles behind, and Pike on the tailboard where he always sat, and Rhea standing at the horses' heads with her slate on her belt. Anwen's bag was already up. Anwen was not. She was standing on the quay with her cap on and her hair pinned under it and her hands in her sleeves, and Kiva and Pru and Jude and Perrin stood round her, because that was how they stood.
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration in the locked adult Calder voice. Quiet observational prose with gentle human warmth, complete thought landings and no theatrical character imitation. Remain in the base narrator throughout.
